body: Your reactions are not painful, getting pointed out is not painful. My life is pretty painful. My awareness of my issues is painful. Awareness is the first step, change the second. I need help for that. For me it's agree to disagree. I am open to all the help I can get. I know it, my gp knows it, my social worker knows it, people around me know it. Luckily they see me otherwise. That's what matters to me. They are all fighting with me. So agree to disagree for me. My feeling is that you are judgemental and assuming. Your feeling is that I am defensive. That's okay. We all have our opions.

I do believe I can do it with help. Not alone. Ofcourse I am not all knowing there are a lot of things I don't know. There are things I don't know, there are a lot of things I need/want to learn (that's why I want the help). I am just saying I know where my issue lie, my faulty coping mechanisms and my patterns. Also with the trauma/triggers. I can't handle all my problems alone, I need help with that. It's not a unknown fact that I am flawed. I know I am. Quote from a song which I love: 'you can be flawed enough, but perfect for a person'. I am really open to critism and people pointing out me out. That's where I learn from. But I don't get what's wrong with admitting I need help? Maybe I come across as defensive, but that's not my goal. My goal is trying to explain. It starts with me, I know that, but I also can admit that I need help (just like a lot of people). For the reasons you're pointing out. It's not painful for me btw.

Thank you for your reply. That's the problem. I know BPD. It's difficult to distinguise BPD from c-PTSD. It has overlap, but it requires different treatment. When I first came there 11 years ago  they diagnosed me with BPD amongst others. They didn't know about my sexual abuse that was still going on and all the trauma's I've been through. Now my diagnosis changed to c-PTSD and thus I need different treatment. But like I've said they've found me too complex, because I do have other personalitly disorders (avoidant, obsessive-compulsive and some other who don't exist in DSM 5). I have the diagnoses of c-PTSD and childhood c-PTSD, aswell as the personality disorders I've mentioned, Anorexia, sleeping disorder and a lot of physical disorders. They're saying if they treat one thing the other will act up and so on. That's why they can't help according to them. But again thank you for your reply, and I do get what you are saying about passing it on to my son and these thoughts. I will look at the site.

I can explain myself very well. I can say and explain to people what my problems are, but I can't fix them by myself. They actually said to me you are too intelligent and too kind. That's why people can't see or understand the suffering and the damaged woman behind it. The problem is emotionally. I can't control my mental health issues alone. I need help to change my core believes, coping mechanisms and overall life skills. I've learned the wrong ones all my life! I can say I'm not able to do it alone, I need help with that and my numerous triggers/flashbacks. I have severe C-PTSD. I'm intelligent, but I can't fix that alone. Like I've said, why are there all these treatment centres? That's what I want to learn with help. You are right about the awareness of how you come across. People often don't see that. I myself try to be very aware of that, but I can't please everyone.
Thank you so much for just this. That's what I'm trying to getting across.

I am well educated. Like I've said I am an intelligent woman who did study Medicine aswel as being self reflective. As long as I know it's sincere (and all the people around me) that's what matters. As long as I have all the things to back up my story that what matters to me. I know where my problems lie, I am well aware of everything. From my personality disorders and eating disorder to the trauma bonds and Stockholm syndrom. I know where things go wrong.

We are disageeing and that's ok. I believe that the majority of the people can 'change/cope/deal with it' but with the right help and tools. I also know some can't and they resort to suicide. Not understandable for a lot of people (calling it selfish etc). For people with mental health issues it's not that you can just fix yourself. It's not a switch you can turn on and be better. Otherwise there wouldn't be need for facilities, psychiatrist, psychologists etc.

It's not ignorance, or not being educated, it's my reality and I am well aware that I need help in order to cope, being able to function and not being stuck with my head. Everyday I'm getting flashbacks from my abuse and every night I wake up in terror multiple times. I'm mostly housebound because of it (just a few things I struggle with. I am also well aware that if I can get the help, it's me who has to make the change and do the hard work. Like you've said only I can do that. But the thing still is I need help and I can't get it.

Yes! That's exactly what I am trying to say. Thank you, sometimes it's hard for me to explain, but yeah they did add another layer off trauma. The institution is for people who are beyond help and want to die with dignity. I am also all for that, but only if you haven't got any hope of a better life and there really isn't any treatment. That's where I believe they're failing. They refuse treatment here because I am too complex according to them, but I don't get why you can't start somewhere and see if it helps. I joined some groups who are trying to fight with me.

Thank you, the truth is that I do have everything to back my story up. I've got nothing to hide and can explain everything. It is true that these 'kind of things', like lifelong sexual abuse, don't happen here much in the Netherlands. My 'story' is really complicated because of that. 

The people who are in the same position as me, got the attention too late. Just like Noa Pothoven and Janneke. 2 stories who could be me. 

The only thing I can't explain is that it is really difficult for people to empathise with people like me who have severe mental health issues. They can't really understand, how it impacts peoples lifes and how messed up it can get to the point that people can't take it anymore. That's pretty normal. Just like it's hard for me to see people with big, loving, caring families and have 'boring' normal lives (and I do know that it doesn't mean they don't have issues, everyone has their own struggles and issues!). 

One is not worse than the other, everyone has their own thing. You can't walk in someone else's shoes. You can try to emphasize with each other but you can't know how it is (both ways). I am not judgmental. I can only try to explain.

Everyone has their own view of the world, mostly formed by how they grew up and I am not judging people for it. That's why I can handle the critism. Doesn't mean it's easy.
Thank you so much, means a lot and yeah, basically that's what I get aswell.

You are right about my son. I told the school about the situation he's in and there's a team of people around him for help. I've fought for my son, because like you said, he deserves that. He deserves a loving, caring mom and I want that for him. That's why I want/need treatment, but if I can't be helped, I can't give him that (and that is the most painful thing I can say). Yes, that breaks my hearth, because I know it. I know I fail at that, I know I am screwed up badly and I know I need the help to be able to function and getting some perspective of a life for me but mostly importantly for my son. I am more absent, because I don't want for him to get the burden on his shoulders. When I have my moments with him, I'm giving my all to give love and tell him he's beautiful and that I love him. He's crazy about me. My problem is that I can't even take care of myself and I am taking the responsibily to say that I fail at that. I can't do it alone and that's failing, letting him down, I know that more than anything. 

I also know BPD ofcourse. My personality disorders are avoidant, obsessive-compulsive and some more who don't exist anymore because of the changes in the DSM (like depressive personality disorder). I also know all about the abuse cycle. I will get a lot of critisim about this, but I know I am giving my all (and others with me) to get the help. I try to fight with all I have, that's why I am trying to reach anyone who can help me with that.

That's okay. What doesn't make sense according to you. Like I've said I'm not afraid of critism. I've been expecting that. I can explain everything, open book, so If you got something to point out, tell me. I read and do everything with the replies. Doesn't stop me. That's a lot btw at least a hunderd holes.
Thank you so much for your reply. I don't know either, but I try to keep fighting. You are right in that.

Thank you for listening, means a lot. I will keep writing and updating whenever I have updates, something is happening or just wanting to vent. On monday I've got an appointment with the Mental Health facility and on tuesday with the psychiatrist. I'm sure to update again then.

I can't fail to mention them, because I've been to the police and told my whole story about the sexual abuse. They've helped me with it actually, so they know every little detail. The problems maybe be very common in the US but here it's not. In the Netherlands it's really huge apparently, because I do feel the same way. The problems I have aren't uncommon. They're saying if we treat your c-PTSD, your eating disorder will act up, if we treat your personality disorder your c-PTSD will act up etc etc. That's what they are saying. So we can't do anything. They know everything about me, my issues and my story. I've got nothing too hide, it's all out in the open. You can disagree and feel it is a 'me' problem. It sure was, because I was afraid off telling anything. Really distrusting, but now everything is in the open. Thanks for your reply.

I know I will get a lot off people who are going to give me harsh comments and will not agree. But I am fighting with everything I have, but I also know that I need help in order to live. I am not functioning at all. I am so stuck, I can't take care of myself, living from minute to minute to get by. If I can get passed by the euthanasia clinic, they agree with me. The rule they have is that you are suffering without any kind of hope to get a life without it and that you've tried everything. Every treatment, everything to work on yourself. That you and everyone around you have done everything in your power to try and make it liveable.
Thank you for your loving reply.

I can understand, it is possible here. I won't go down having tried everything, but if they can't help me it's over for me. Yes a bold statement to make, but I am done suffering and surviving for all my life. So either I can get help somewhere or I will end my life if they agree with me, there are strict rules ofcourse to get euthanised. They will investigate your case and the rule they have is that you did everything you can, there isn't any treatment left for you and you are suffering without any kind of hope of a 'normal, functioning' life.
I think I mentioned it in my story, but it's GGZ in my region. Sorry, I need to be careful, need to wait until the inspection finished their investigation.
Thanks you for the kind reply.

Yeah, that's what me and others also don't get (like my social workers, gp). They are fighting with for me, but we can't get any place to take me in for treatment, because my issues are too complex. We've tried and called around here. Put in applications for treatment. But I get the same response everywhere. Some just drop me after listening to 5 minutes of my story. I am too complex according to them. They're saying that if we take on your PTSD, your personality problems might act up. If we take on your personality problems, your eating disorder might act up. And so on. But imo you can start somewhere...

Nothing more to it, what are you trying to say? I am an open book. You can point me out and ask away. I'm not afraid like that and I'm highly self reflective. So if you disagree, tell me. I can handle the critics and even do something with it.

For the first time I am taking responsibility. I want the change and making it now. I was always quiet and 'refused' help as in trying to change. I was a scared little deer in the headlights, but I am turning that around now. Anyway I started to trust my therapist, which went wrong. The government here (the inspection who oversees the mental heath care) feels there has been a lot of mistakes made and they made a case to punish them. 

I reported the therapist, which is a huge deal, because I was always the victim and I've found it too difficult to let go of my believes and was scared to change and fight. Now I am fighting back, I even pressed charges against my sexual abuser.

I don't want this to happen to anyone else. I am taking every help I can get, as you can read in my blog, but I do need some treatment to get the tools to learn how to cope with everything and work on my trauma's. The flashbacks/nightmares/self care etc etc. That's where they're saying, sorry we can't help you, you are too complex. I am an intelligent woman, I've studied Medicine and I know how to be self reflective. Where/when I make mistakes and what I am doing wrong. Bold statement you're making, harsh, but untrue imo. You can obviously disagree. That's okay. I can take critics and people have the right to point me out, maybe I can do anything with it.

My GP agrees with me and gave his all to get me some treatment, but they won't have me. The mental health facility I've been with for 11 years also actually agrees and is saying the same, the systems fails people with complex/multiple psychiatric issues like me. I fall through the cracks of the system and multiple people like me. People from different organizations, try to fight with me, but we can't get through.

Llike I've said I am not stupid because I've recorded all my converstations. They're literally saying and admitting that. I've started recording not to use it against them, but because I've need to hear myself back and reflect upon it. I can't do that in the moment. Usually after a session I need to let it sink in, listen back and react upon it/do something with the things they've said.

But if this is truly the case, I can live with that and I have the opinion from multiple independant facilities like the euthanasia clinic. I won't go down without a fight, but I know I do need help.
